tools.description: List the email clients this deployment can render right now, with their rendering tier, engine, and capabilities
tools.name: list_clients

tools.description: Submit an email for rendering across email clients — full HTML, or a complete raw .eml (base64). Provide exactly one of html/eml. Returns a job ID to poll for results.

eml.description: A complete raw RFC 822 message (.eml), base64-encoded — inserted verbatim (real headers, multipart, attachments). Max 10MB decoded. Provide exactly one of html or eml.

html.description: The full email HTML to preview. Provide exactly one of html or eml.

include_previews.description: Also capture the inbox-list row (how the message looks unread in the list) and the subject heading, returned as inbox_preview / subject_preview on each render. Default false: they cost more than the body render itself, so ask only when you need them.

renders.description: Exactly the renders you want, one entry each (e.g. outlook light + outlook dark are two entries). Omit for the server default: every live client at its default width, light.

color_scheme.description: Render in the client's light or dark mode (default light). Dark must be supported by the client — check color_schemes in list_clients.

images_disabled.description: Render with remote images blocked (default false)

viewport_width.description: Viewport width in pixels (200-2560). Defaults to the client default (1280).

tools.name: submit_preview

tools.description: Get the status and screenshots for a preview job. Poll until status is "completed".

job_id.description: The job ID returned by submit_preview

tools.name: get_job

tools.description: Fetch a rendered screenshot. Returns the image URL for the given job, client, width, and environment (color scheme / images).

images_disabled.description: Whether the render had images blocked

viewport_width.description: Viewport width of the render, matching the job (1280 when the job used client defaults)

tools.name: get_screenshot
